gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: At no time did we think that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.sentence: It ___ that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.hint: it occurred to sb = sb thought
gaps.explanation: 'At no time did we think' becomes 'it never occurred to us'.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: The plane takes one hour; the train takes two.
gaps.explanation: half the time = twice as fast as.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.
